note.title: Celebrity culture
note.specFocus: famous people, media influence, role models, fame and achievements
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
2.3 Celebrity culture
Key focus
- famous people, media influence, role models, fame and achievements.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Support opinions with evidence; use relative clauses and comparatives without confusing who/what is being discussed.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: My favourite singer writes his own songs and also plays the piano.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Il mio cantante preferito scrive le sue canzoni e suona anche il pianoforte.”

Give two talents of the favourite singer.

questions.modelAnswer: The athlete won the race despite an injury.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“L’atleta ha vinto la gara nonostante un infortunio.”

What did the athlete achieve, and what challenge did she face?

questions.modelAnswer: Many young people copy the style of famous people they see on social media.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Molti giovani imitano lo stile dei famosi che vedono sui social.”

What do many young people copy, and where do they see it?

questions.modelAnswer: A good role model should use their fame to help others.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Un buon modello dovrebbe usare la propria fama per aiutare gli altri.”

How should a good role model use fame?

questions.modelAnswer: Last year I met an actor after a presentation.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“L’anno scorso ho incontrato un attore dopo una presentazione.”

Whom did the speaker meet last year, and when?

questions.modelAnswer: I prefer famous people who talk honestly about their mistakes.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Preferisco i personaggi che parlano sinceramente dei loro errori.”

What kind of famous people are preferred, and why?
